editorial.name: Owner.com
editorial.descriptionZh: 给单体餐厅做线上获客与点单的 SaaS：餐厅官网与 SEO、Google 评价引擎、在线菜单与点单、品牌 App、会员积分和 AI 电话接单装在一套里。
editorial.takeawayZh: 给单店配一套自己的点单站和营销系统
editorial.noteZh: 首屏白底，正中两行灰黑大字 The AI platform restaurants use to grow online discovery.，下面一个输入框写 Find your restaurant name，配深绿按钮 Get my AI report；再往下是一台 iPhone 截图，屏幕上是一份 Website health 评分 36/100，底下标着 Poor——等于把潜客餐厅的线上表现直接打分摆出来。往下 Grow sales like these owners 一节拼了整面店主战绩：Hengameh Stanfield 的 $192,000 Sales growth in 30 days、Mo and Omar 的 +$7M In direct online sales、Sandy Sei 的 +$104,500 Online sales 挨着排。顶部导航长到要分栏，Product 下面就列了 Restaurant SEO、Reviews Engine、Listings Management、Online Ordering、Smart Upsells、AI Phone Ordering、Kitchen Tablet 十几项。
editorial.pricing: unknown（导航有 Pricing，首页只给 Get a free demo）

reasons.statement: 页面交付的是 Owner.com 这套餐厅经营系统的功能清单与 Get a free demo 入口，首页主体是产品模块与店主案例，按产品官网归入单站展示。

pages.title: Online Ordering and Restaurant Marketing System | Owner.com
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

shot.alt: Owner.com 首屏：The AI platform restaurants use to grow online discovery.

facts.value: 输入餐厅名即生成 AI report，首页给的示例是 Website health 36/100 标 Poor
facts.evidence: 首屏输入框 Find your restaurant name 配 Get my AI report 按钮，下面手机截图显示评分环与 Poor 字样

facts.value: Restaurant Website、Restaurant SEO、Online Menu、Reviews Engine、Listings Management、Online Ordering、Smart Upsells、AI Phone Ordering、Branded Restaurant App、Kitchen Tablet 等
facts.evidence: Product 下拉里逐项带一句说明，如 Point of Sale 标 New、AI Phone Ordering 标 Waitlist

facts.value: 首页摆出十几位店主的增长数字，例：+$7M In direct online sales、$192,000 Sales growth in 30 days、+54% Sales growth
facts.evidence: Grow sales like these owners 一节按店主姓名与门店逐条列出金额，每条指向一个 /case-studies/ 页面

facts.value: 自报 4.8 分、1,000+ 条评价，并自称 Rated #1 Restaurant Software Leader in Summer 2026
facts.evidence: 首屏上方 4.8 across 1,000+ reviews 一行，以及 See why we're rated #1 in restaurant tech 一节
